nom: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Face Lotion SPF 30 Dark Spot Corrector

avis.texte: Dermatologist recommended Radiant Tone for facial dark spot and I have used all three products, Radiant tone SPF day cream, Night Cream and Serum consistently, 2-3 times daily for six months and can see little if any change. Very disappointed in these products. Should I not see some improvement by now?
I have used your lotion for years, it has been the best. But you keep changing it. I am now very disappointed. I can not find face lotion for my face now

Having both severely oily skin and moderate to severe rosacea makes it somewhat difficult to find an appropriate sunscreen. I bought this on a whim and must say I am very pleased. No added irritation and works fine under both powder and balm foundation. Took off one star for heavy fragrance (why do they put fragrance in any skincare?). I have not used it long enough to see if it decreases any discoloration but I'm content to just use it for sunscreen purposes.

This product works great as a sun screen but slowly caused blocked pores and breakouts on the bottom half of my face. The product is supposed to be non-comedogenic but that is not the case. With a price like that, I expect a better quality product. The red spot I was trying to get rid of didn't go away either. It's only slightly less visible.

I've had melasma for almost 25 years - nothing has really worked in any meaningful way. I've tried everything and have even used Retin A for over 10 years. Since Thiamidol is the only thing I've not tried, was excited to use this. After 2 weeks, it seems to be lightening my patches a bit, very excited however, I can't tolerate the smell any longer - in the trash it goes!
This sunscreen is not sticky, has some great ingredients that help with discoloration, but it pills very badly and it's very irritating and causes my eyes to sting a lot.
This helps my acne scars fade quickly. I have sensitive skin and this doesnt irritate me. It also doesnt pill or cake under my makeup.

I like that this is a combination sunscreen and moisturizer, and it also is supposed to help with dark spots. However, when I use this on top of the spotless brightening serum, it pills really badly. You can't put on make up on top of this lotion either (even without the serum underneath) because it will pill as well. That's too bad because I like the ingredients in this lotion, and it's always nice to have a combo sunscreen/moisturizer.

This has been amazing at quickly healing/reducing the post acne inflammation and pigmentation I tend to get because I can't leave it alone. Better than anything else I've tried. That Thiamidol is the real deal. Old marks fading within a week (using 3x/day) and new spots are barely getting a chance to stick around. But wow is this aggressively scented and I'm not one to be sensitive to fragrance or care if something is scented. It fades eventually but its a bit much.

I struggle with acne and combo skin. literally from Sahara to oil city. I have a lot of dark spots from previous acne. I have tried creams and spot treatments specifically for dark spots and nothing has worked like this cream has. I have currently no breakouts and my skin is a lot more balanced. This has been a god send I am so thankful. And I have used it at night time and morning with no problem what so ever.
The smell is way too strong and not a pleasant smell either. I dont know if it wouod work or not bc i cant get past the smell which doesnt go away

Im so glad they upgraded there game on this product. This brand is the only face lotion I can use that doesn't make my face greasy or leave it still feeling dry. The fact that it has the top spf protection is amazing.
I developed an allergy to this product that made my entire face swell and landed me in Urgent Care. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

I've been using this for about 3-4 weeks and there's noticeable fading on the sunspots across my upper forehead, which gets the most sun exposure...hate the way it smells but I'm so impressed with the results so far I'll definitely see it through!

I have used Eucerin products for 30 years. I don't know if Radiant Tone daily lotion 30 works or not because I plan on returning it because it smells so bad. Never knew Eucerin products had perfume in them. Guess I've been lucky to get the unscented ones. Please make this product unscented.

I tried it because I've used the serum frkm the same brand; it does not mix well with the rest of my skin care routine and it balls up, so it is better if is used by itself. I am not refraining myself from using my usual skin care products, so I stopped using this one. I keep using the serum though.

I am very disappointed in these eucerin products. It made my face very dry and it burns when I apply the products. I use the regular eucerin cream and it helps. So I was surprised that these products did the opposite.
This lotion is good for indoors or not so hot days outside. This product works with the whole collection and prevents me from getting more Dark spots.
great on brown skin tone. easily absorbed. spf is a added plus

I appreciate being selected to try this product but I was not a fan of it. It was too thick/heavy for my skin, ( I have acne, oily skin so I'm very careful if a product is too heavy for my skin because it will within a couple days break me out ) I tried to use this product for a month to be able to give a thorough review but I started getting breakouts so I thought maybe 2 weeks? But the breakouts started becoming more & more & also it's heavily fragrance in my opinion & I don't like fragrance in my skincare ( I can do earthy, herbal, oats, etc but I prefer fragrance free, this one smells like straight florals ), the good thing is the scent did faint within a couple hours, I wanted to see if it helps with my dark spot since it says it's geared towards that but because of the breakouts & the scent I couldn't continue using it & ended up gifting to my mom who don't have a sensitive skin like mine & also I didn't feel it was moisturizing.

This provides a nice moisture to your face without feeling heavy on the skin. It has the added bonus of spf to help keep your face from burning. Great product for the summer months when I'm outside more. I received this product for my honest review.

It rubs in really well, leaves no white cast, and doesn't feel greasy (although it LOOKS a little greasy). HOWEVER. It smells EXACTLY like Formula 409 lemon scented multi-surface cleaner, and the second time I used it, it burned my face and stung my eyes.
Non-greasy texture, absorbs quickly, pleasant smell, gift from pinchme
It is the best product I have ever used in my life. It is wonderful for oily skin. The protection factor is very good. It quickly makes the skin soft at the same time and does not make the skin dry.

avis.titre: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30
avis.texte: I was happy when I was chosen to try the Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 because I am always looking for and trying new skincare products to add the best ones to my everyday routine. This Eucerin Lotion did not disappoint. It goes on easily, smoothly and evenly. It doesn't have a greasy or sticky feel and it doesn't leave your skin too greasy, oily or sticky. My skin definitely looks more even and brighter and feels smoother and refreshed after using it. The SPF 30 is an added benefit, especially now that it's getting nicer and warmer out, so I will be spending more time outdoors and in the sun. SPF protection is very important for my skin health and my overall health. Now that I'm 41, I definitely need to take better care of my skin and do a better job at protecting it and this product helps me do that.

I purchased the daily lotion and dark spot serum. I believe i am allergic to one of the ingredients in these products. After use my face immediately broke out in a rash/hives. I wish i could return and get my money back.
I received it for free. I loved it , I've been using it for a while and started to fade the dark spots. Also protected from sunburn. It's lightweight, non sticky and non comedogenic.

This lotion has helped me reduce some sun spots and redness, and it makes my skin feel hydrated. The consistency is very light. SPF 30 is great for daily use. The smell is something I don't like. It smells like sunscreen.
Well I'm always looking for products that will help me with my melasma, so I think this product works very well.
I received this as a free sample from pinch me. This is a nice hydrating lotion that gives you a little glow, bonus with the spf!

avis.titre: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30
avis.texte: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion with SPF 30 I received for free has been a solid addition to my morning routine. It's lightweight, blends in easily, and doesn't leave a white cast, which I really appreciate. My skin feels moisturized all day, and I've noticed it looking a bit more even over time. Love that it gives me sun protection without feeling like I'm wearing sunscreen.

avis.titre: Block the harm enjoy the sun
avis.texte: You can comfortably be outside trusting the benefits knowing you are protected from the harmful risks … block the harm enjoy the sun

This face lotion doesn't have a sticky or greasy feel. The dark spots on my face are starting to get lighter after a little over of month of using. My skin looks more even in color. I've already recommended this lotion to friends and family. I'm definitely going to look into buy the whole line.
Love that it doesn't leave a white cast after applying, it feels nice and smooth on my face and it stay on.
Nice texture and didn't make my skin irritated. Love any lotion with added spf
I was able to try Eucerin daily lotion for my honest opinions and I thought it was great. It is super easy to put on my face and I love how smooth it feels after. Added bonus that it has SPF.

I've been a long-time user of Eucerin products, and I was excited to try the Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Face Lotion with Broad Spectrum SPF 30. This lotion is specifically designed to help reduce the appearance of dark spots, and I can confidently say it has lived up to its promises.
Helps moisturize, not greasy, easy to apply. Will definitely be buying!
I like that this prdict has sun protection. It went on smoothly and made skin feel great
I was thoroughly impressed with this Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion. I love that it has SPF 30 in it as well.
I got this as a free sample to try. I can't wait to purchase it. It's a really great face lotion that makes your skin look more radiant and bright.

avis.titre: Moisturizing but did not fade dark spots
avis.texte: I enjoyed the moisturizing benefits of this lotion, and also it was pleasantly unscented. However, i have a dark spot on my hand that I applied it daily on, and it did not fade at all.

I got this product for free on pinchme, and here are my honest thoughts on it. It comes with a pump, so it's an easy nice clean way to get the lotion without the mess and fast convenient on the go. The scent is light and clean and not intense or strong. The texture was creamy and smooth to apply unlike some other sunscreens where it's too sticky and hard to spread on the face. The only problem for me personally is that it's not on the more natural ingredients side as I would like. But other than that it was a positive experience with this sunscreen.

This product was received free. Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 is not a product that I will be using again. I did not see any results in the month that I tested this product. I also have what I like to call selective sensitive skin because I can use the same products everyday and just randomly one of the products will start to discomfort me then be perfectly fine the next day. This product made my face feel itchy every day. But I see this as a me problem not a product problem because everyone reacts differently. It may work amazingly for you so I recommend trying it to see if you have better results than I did.

i liked this formula because though it was sun screen, it still felt light on my face. still not the biggest fan of the feeling of sun screen goop on my face, the feeling is definitely still there but not terrible. no white cast

I got a sample of this product in exchange for an honest review. I haven't used a lot of this because I'm breastfeeding and want to avoid chemical sunscreens, but I would definitely use this at another time in my life. My only real complaint is that I want a higher SPF. I trust Eucerin products and they don't irritate my sensitive skin. I think this works well on my skin, but I have not tried it under or over makeup, just on bare skin.

avis.titre: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30
avis.texte: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 worked as a sunscreen. However, besides protecting my face from the sun there were no discernable changes in my skin. I have had better success with other Eucerin daily lotion products (tinted moisturizer and immersive hydration) which I loved. This one wasn't for me.
The texture and tone are acceptable but the shade seems a bit limited. I'm not sure it would work for me year-round. However, I like spf level and it's ease of use.
I love that the product is not sticky and you can build make up underneath it. It has a pleasant smell and gets absorbed by the skin easily.

avis.titre: Great lotion with bonus sun protection
avis.texte: Got to try this as a free sample. Pleased with the light feel, easy application and fun protection. Left my skin feeling soft, hydrated and provided protection from the sun.

I love this lotion! It is so creamy and makes my skin feel amazing! It has a soft clean smell. A little goes a lomg way. I need this for a full body lotion. I did get to try this for free. So glad I did! It has great benefits. Including spf protection. Definitely recommend the lotion.

Great moisturizer and SPF combo !! It's super nourishing and non greasy! You apply your serum and eye cream then the Eucerin radiant tone daily lotion 30 and go! It's a must for a girl on the go that won't skip out on SPF!
I love it! Now with the sun hitting hard I barely feel like my face is getting burnt.

I received this sample free to try from Pinchme. I'm really starting to like eucerin skincare. It's affordable and works well. I loved that this had SPF and did not leave a white cast. I haven't noticed much changes with dark spots, but I will continue to use. I really liked this lotion and would recommend.

I recently received this lotion for free, I was previously using foundation with sunscreen in it but they were usually oily which did not pair well with my already oily skin. This lotion is great cause I can know my face is protected while still being able to use the foundation I prefer. It seems to absorb and dry well without leaving a weird feeling.
It works as intended and doesn't feel greasy at all. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Nice product and easy to use
avis.texte: I have enjoyed using this product so far. It is easy to use, doesn't sting my eyes, and applies nicely. Bonus that it actually smells pretty good for a sunscreen product!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I love other Eucerin products, and had high hopes for this moisturizer with sunscreen. While I was happy with the moisturizing properties, the scent of the sunscreen was too much for my preference, and it did leave a white cast on my skin. I would not mind wearing this to a beach or a pool where people are "expected" to have sunscreen on, but I would not wear this under my makeup every day.

I was super surprised to see that I was sent a full size bottle as a free sample of this product. I'm even more amazed at how well it hydrates my skin and the noticeable difference I've already seen just in the one month I've been using the product. It pairs well with my retinol treatment by providing SPF coverage and dehydration, just what I needed!

My skin felt so soft and looked so radiant after just a few uses. I can see a difference in the tiny lines around my eyes already. It's light and airy without a greasy feel. I definitely Recommend using this if you like skincare with SPF. You won't be disappointed

I was very happy to get to try the Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 for free from PINCHME. The formula was just ok and I haven't seen any difference in my skin. Overall, I was pleased to have tried but I don't think ill be purchasing.
This lotion smells nice and applies nicely without feeling oily or greasy on my skin. I feel protected from the sun with the SPF 30. I got to try the Eucerin radiant tone with SPF for free.
Eucerin, please remove the fragrance from this line. Do not recommend as this product.

avis.titre: Not as good as I hoped!
avis.texte: I wasn't a big fan of this moisturizer. It seemed to get the job done, but I like my other moisturizers better! This one seemed to clash with something in my skincare routine and it made my skin burn!
I was searching a good quality Spf lotion this one totally meets my need. I really liked the texture as well as effectiveness. I definitely recommend this product.
This adds the perfect level of moisture and sun protection. Plus it helped lighten my dark spots noticeably within the first weeks.

I'm never really thought I would like this product very much, because I had Not used it before. However I was pleasantly surprised when it did take away or well lessens my 1 lil dark spot. Only time will tell what it's really going to take it away completely or not!

After washing my face with cleansing foam, I then clean it again with toner and then apply Eucerin sunscreen, which for me is the best, it leaves my skin dry all day long. Before, my skin was very red when I started using it, it improved.

I received this full size Eurecin spf 30 lotion for free. I had never tried this brand or product, i was pleased with it. The texture is creamy and hydrating not thick or sticky. It leaves face and hands feeling moisturized plus protected from sun. Definitely recommend
It wasn't that good. Alot of chemicals in this. It didn't do well on my skin.

I absolutely love this lotion! It makes my skin feel so silky, smooth. It has a nice, scent-free consistency and is moisturizing. Doesn't leave a white cast and absorbs nicely. I receive this product in exchange of my honest review.

avis.titre: It may work better for you
avis.texte: So I've been using this consistently for a few weeks and I'm gonna be honest. The SPF properties are more forgiving than the even tone properties. I do spend a good bit of time in the sun now that it's getting warmer and I'm a good caramel complexion that doesn't care for a tan cause my skin is already uneven. I will say after hours in the sun the SPF in this lotion is phenomenal but that's about it. The part of it that says it will help even out your tone or lessen the dark marks you may have...well...not the whole truth. It is a moisturizing product, and again the spf is great and it doesn't leave a white cast or make me look ashy so if they just wanna make it strictly a sunscreen then I'd totally hand over my wallet no hesitation but if your main concern is dark marks then I would not purchase.
after receiving this free product and using it. i really liked the way it melted into my skin and the spf is a wonderful addition.
I love this Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 it's amazing it feels great on my skin not oily,dry or leaving white marks on me

avis.titre: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30
avis.texte: I received the Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 from Pinchme to try for an honest review. It was ok as a sunscreen, I don't see any changes on the dark spot on my face.
This Radiant Tone facial lotion makes my skin feel instantly hydrated and glowing. I love that it has SPF so I can wear this outside without the worry of getting sunburned.
I loved it. It's a lotion that absorbs very well, doesn't feel heavy, and keeps my face hydrated.
Loving the radiant tone with spf cream. It goes on clear which is a major plus. Doesn't leave a cast on my skin and feels lightweight.
SPF often feels heavy or greasy, but this felt flawless on the skin. It didn't irritate my eyes either!

I restsd it out on a Florida vacation and I came back with no sunburn and nicely moisturizer skin. I didn't try pairing it with any sort of makeup or foundation so I am not sure how it would pair with that. But on its own it worked well
This is a great daily Moisturizer with sunscreen. Lightweight and great fresh scent. I recommend!

I recieved the Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 free for review. That in no way changes my honest opinion of this product. A little product goes a long way. One pump from the dispenser was more than enough to use on my entire face and neck area. The product did take a little time to absorb into my skin fully before I felt comfortable applying my makeup. It did not feel greasy or heavy, and really help keep my skin from sun damage during our vacation. My skin seemed to stay very hydrated and plump feeling for days while using this product.

I am such a huge fan of Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30! This is a non greasy, easily absorbable sunscreen and moisturizer all in one which cuts two steps into one in my daily beauty routine, and what is my favorite thing is the glow that results from using this amazing product! Some days I just cleanse and slap this on my face and go and I have radiant and glowing skin all day!
The eucerin cream with SPF. It went on smooth. Easy to apply. Moisturized my face but not a long lasting moisturizer.
This made my skin feel amazing and look amazing. It wasn't too sticky and blended nicely. It seemed to natuarally hide my redder spots.

I received a free sample of Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30, from PinchMe, in exchange for my honest opinion. I am already a fan of the Eucerin brand, they make quality skin care that feels protective and healthy on your skin. I loved using this SPF 30 facial sunscreen from Eucerin, after using it consistently for only a couple of weeks, I noticed a reduction in the look of the dark spots on my face. I regularly use sunscreen, but getting some dark spots are unavoidable as you age and because of acne scars and what not. I can't wait to continue to use the sunscreen because it not only protects my skin from further damage from the sun, but I really appreciate that it has skin care ingredients as well to help reduce the look of the dark spots on my skin. It has a lightweight creamy formula, absorbs quickly and it has a lightly herbal smell, which dissipates quickly as it absorbs into your skin. I absolutely recommend this for more healthy looking skin that glows from within!
Anyday anytime perfect for everyday use. Also added sunscreen so has everything you need.

avis.titre: Nice lightweight moisturizer, can't speak to lightening b...
avis.texte: I received a free sample of this moisturizer to try. I don't think any moisturizer will have enough active ingredients to actually lighten dark spots, so I can't say I saw any difference in that respect, but this had a nice texture and it's nice that it has SPF even if 30 is a bit low for my preference. Overall not a product that has a lot of relevance in my routine, but if you just want a little sun protection and a little brightening benefits, this may be for you.
I absolutely love this.. if u haven't got any please get some

I received a sample of Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion to give feedback about the product. This worked good for my skin and felt hydrating. The only thing I didn't like was the smell of the product.

I've been using Eucerin as my daily SPF moisturizer for about a year and was very excited to try this radiant tone moisturizer by them instead. I had very high hopes and was pleasantly surprised! My face felt moisturized and glowy all day long, but I didn't have any of the sticky, greasy feelings like I do with other moisturizers. It's lightweight and looks good by itself or as a base layer for my minimal makeup routine!

I received the Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 as a free trial and I must say, I love it!!! It is so lightweight and non-greasy! I love that it has the SPF30 so my skin is protected while out in the sun! I have recommended it to so many people!
Leaves ur skin radiant. I wear it any day or type of weather.

avis.titre: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30
avis.texte: Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 works pretty good for sun protection. And I have noticed my dark spots have faded slightly.

I received Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 for free from pinchme.com in exchange for an honest review of the product. I was looking for a facial sunscreen for running, but sadly this states it's not for sweaty or water situations. It has a very light and smooth texture with low sunscreen odor. I'm sure it would work great under makeup. I also appreciate that it uses safer sunscreen chemicals than many competitors. I'm sure it's a great sunscreen, just doesn't work for my needs.
I've used Eucerin for years. They always use quality and safe ingredients and this one works pretty well.

I received a free sample of the Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 from PinchMe in exchange for my review. Overall it isn't a bad lotion. The scent is a bit much. It moisturizes well and absorbs easily. I like that it has sunscreen in it.

avis.titre: Definitely a sunscreen smell, but feels nice
avis.texte: Love the way this moisturizers my skin. It does have a lingering smell, so if you're sensitive to fragrance or that sunscreen smell, this may not be for you. This gives me a nice radiance too, but not so much where I look so shiny. A nice healthy glow

Pinchme sent me the Eucerin Radiant Tone sunscreen in exchange for my review. The SPF is very good and doesn't leave residue but it doesn't work well with my skincare or with makeup. Works well when used alone.

I cannot believe that I'm actually obsessed with a product from Eucerin as much as I am obsessed with this radiant tone daily lotion sunscreen. They stepped it up with this entire line! The sunscreen is spf + skincare! It protects your skin from uv rays that could cause cancer but also has ingredients to help with evening skin tone and dark spots. It's a chemical sunscreen. There is zero white cast. The formula is soft and dewy and hydrating. But it's super lightweight and blends in so easily. I'm a mega fan!!!
I liked this face cream. It went on easily and rubbed it well. I think the scent is a little strong, but it dissipates quickly, so it was manageable.
I received this product for free to test it out. And to my surprise I really liked it. It is lightweight, smells good and hydrates my face very well.

I received this product free and return for my honest review. I wanted to try this out because I have been wanting to find a sunscreen that I could use that wouldn't break out my face. It has a very light scent and it does not have a greasy feel to it when applying it. The only downfall I had was it clogged my pores and I did break out. Otherwise it was pretty good all around besides that. I just have sensitive skin.
I like this as a daily sunscreen to wear. It's is light weight

I appreciate how easy this was to apply, how nicely it rubbed in, and how it didn't leave me feeling greasy. I did have a slight problem with it causing my skin to peel the first couple of times, but it was fine after that.

I received Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 for free from PINCHME. This product felt very nice on my skin and was lightweight. It is a product I will use daily, and I love that it has SPF. A nice everyday moisturizer, and something that will replace what I used to use. Highly recommend this product.

I received Eucerin's radiant tone sunscreen for free in exchange for my review. I typically use multiple brightening products and traded all of them for this single sunscreen. I was blown away that I could achieve the same results in 1 product versus 3-4 each morning. It moisturized very well, absorbs quickly and does not leave any white cast as with some sunscreens. I have had great protection from the sun; no burns or redness. I also had no problem applying makeup over it. It actually provides a good base for it. This stuff is amazing.
I prefer tinted sunscrwith less of a sunscreen smell but it did the job

I received this lotion for free in exchange for a review. I really liked this lotion. It did have a slightly odd smell but I still liked the lotion and using it. I also like that it has sunscreen in it.

I received a sample of this product for free. So far, I haven't been able to test how effective the sunscreen is (winter) or dark spot correction(need more time), but the cream felt amazing! It is super lightweight, not oily or greasy like most sunscreen products. I am very excited to see the results.

I've been using this daily and it has reduced the appearance of dark spots and has made my face even-toned. It has a creamy texture and is lightweight on my skin. It has made my skin smooth and hydrated and my face feels plump and soft.
I thought it worked very well. I used it in the mornings and seem like I could feel and see changes by the end of a week.

I received a free bottle of Eucerin Radiant Tone daily lotion 30, in exchange for an honest review. It goes on smooth and you get full coverage with spf30 from the sun, but goes on like a lotion. No white residue, it's not sticky.

The Eucerin Radiant Tone Daily Lotion SPF 30 is an excellent skincare product that provides both moisturization and sun protection, making it ideal for daily use. The lotion is formulated to hydrate and improve skin tone while offering broad-spectrum SPF 30 protection, which is essential for shielding the skin from harmful UV rays and preventing sun damage. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving it feeling soft, smooth, and moisturized without a heavy or sticky residue. What sets this lotion apart is its brightening effect. Over time, it helps even out skin tone and improve radiance, making it a great option for those with dull or uneven skin. The lotion is also fragrance-free and suitable for sensitive skin, which is a big plus. While it may not offer intense anti-aging benefits, it effectively combines hydration, sun protection, and skin tone enhancement, making it a solid daily skincare essential.
Moisturized well but does take a bit of rubbing in to avoid any residue

This face cream felt pretty nice on the skin and absorbed in quickly. I felt hydrated and it sat well under makeup. I like that it has spf in it to protect my face from more signs of aging but I am not sure if I saw that much of a difference in the tone of my skin other than glow from hydration.

Received this as a sample and tried it out during my everyday activities. I enjoyed that the pump is easy and the product is easy to apply with your hands. The smell is amazing and it left my skin feeling plump and moisturized. My skin looks more glowy along with being less dull after using and I definitely recommend the Radiant Glow Spf.
Great product! Smooth finish. Not too oily or heavy on the skin.
